firmwareUnknowns.summary: The real base accepted the captured Candidate A operations, but this does not establish a universal LOOI profile or protocol-ready state.
Android reported a successful read of two bytes, but the raw payload was not retained and is intentionally omitted rather than reconstructed.
Candidate B remains covered by deterministic fake traces only and was not executed on hardware.

notes: Physical Candidate A experiment on Samsung SM-S928B, Android 16/API 36 and a real LOOI base. FED5 and FED9 notification subscriptions completed before two FEDA writes (01 then 03), followed by a successful FED8 read of two bytes. The app showed all four Candidate A steps successful. No drive, FE00, FF02, movement, light, head, heartbeat, telemetry, or protocol-ready promotion was used. Event timestamps are relative ordering because the diagnostic flow did not retain per-operation wall-clock timestamps.
